verdict.rationale: Khoj documents a web admin panel for configuring server settings, including adding agents, and says models, host URL and feature enablement are customizable. That offers a GUI alternative to hand-editing config files, but nothing describes a guided first-run wizard. Some settings, such as telemetry opt-out, are still set through environment variables. Missing for 10: a guided first-run setup wizard, step-by-step model credential entry, channel setup inside onboarding, defaults selection during first run, and any hands-on corroboration of the setup experience.
